title: Expose protected phone continuation and shared expiry

gates.name: QR continuation API tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/promo/test_qr_continuation_api.py

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

evidence_required: FT-006-AC-001 RED: the current client/backend surface has no exact public QR exchange or protected phone session/media/activity boundary; GREEN: a valid ticket reaches the same session without a selfie, exposes the exact phone shape and CTA, preserves soft-delete/historical-N continuity, skips only unavailable issued media without rebuild/recalculation, and deterministic browser/API fixtures prove the same issued session/content join and immutable session-row diff across media states; decisive comparison: exact HTTP/client traces, fixture session/content join and immutable session-row diff. The representative-phone scan of the exact FT-005 display-expiry QR is deferred to post-deployment pilot validation; artifact: isolated API/client and redacted fixture evidence under .tasks/TASK-081-T3-FT-006-W2/.

FT-006-AC-002 RED: the current surface cannot perform repeated real QR exchanges from multiple phones against one shared access context; GREEN: every valid first/repeated scan uses one session row, each repeated scan and explicit cross-phone activity advances the same browser_last_seen_at, passive access never advances it, and one 60-minute idle boundary expires all phones irreversibly; decisive comparison: controlled concurrent multi-phone HTTP/state traces, one-row cardinality and timestamps across scan/activity/passive/expiry operations; artifact: isolated multi-phone lifetime evidence under .tasks/TASK-081-T3-FT-006-W2/.

FT-006-AC-003 RED: the current surface does not prove independent QR first-open/browser-idle expiry or personalized-state isolation in a real browser; GREEN: controlled display, cooldown, first-open and shared-idle clocks remain independent, and a central-origin playwright cli flow proves cookie-protected reads/activity, local timer handling, rendered-state clearing before location.replace, no durable browser state, no-referrer/no-store behavior and post-expiry rejection without prior personal data; decisive comparison: browser/HTTP/state observations before and at each exact expiry boundary; artifact: Playwright CLI transcript, screenshots, video and trace plus isolated security evidence under .tasks/TASK-081-T3-FT-006-W2/.

FT-006-AC-004 RED: the current backend has no configured limiter covering /q, /phone and /api/phone/*; GREEN: positive deployment-backed phone limit/window settings instantiate one promo-boundary single-backend limiter, Caddy-forwarded clients receive separate budgets, and excess on every exact route returns 429 before personalized disclosure; decisive comparison: configured under/over-limit exact-route responses, client-key separation and redacted logs/artifacts; artifact: isolated rate-limit integration evidence under .tasks/TASK-081-T3-FT-006-W2/.
purpose: Complete and prove the participant-visible multi-phone continuation as one protected, rate-limited public boundary over the promo-owned shared state and accepted read-only media projections.
success_outcome: Valid first/repeated QR scans and explicit activity share one lifetime across phones, the same protected session renders without stale leakage, every public route enforces configured 429 limiting, and deterministic browser/API proof closes the implementation continuation contract; the physical-phone join is deferred to post-deployment pilot validation.
anti_goals: Do not implement the separate purchase/selfie-search page; navigate to the configured absolute HTTPS target without personalized parameters.
Do not add participant login, per-device grants, refresh tokens, public MinIO/presigned URLs, media cache, replacement selection or session rebuild.
Do not mutate Photo, processing, serving-control, display or immutable Promo session truth from transport/client code.
Do not merge display expiry or success cooldown into phone access invalidation.
Do not add a distributed limiter, external edge-rate-limit service, shared limiter framework or new dependency; reuse the existing single-backend pattern inside the promo phone boundary.

forbidden_scope: Foreign capability writes, raw MinIO keys and production participant/session data
Purchase-page implementation, redirect allow-list service and second client origin
Ticket/cookie plaintext, personalized response bodies or referrer/query secrets in logs and artifacts
stop_conditions: The public boundary cannot preserve promo ownership while using only accepted inventory/processing projections.
A passive read, media load, timer, polling or page-visibility event would extend shared access.
A hard-purged teaser requires replacement selection, session rebuild, N recalculation or foreign state mutation.
Expired HTML/API/media/CTA paths cannot clear rendered state and redirect or reject without disclosing prior personalized data.
A positive configured public-route limit cannot cover every exact phone path with deterministic 429 behavior and forwarded-client separation.

The required central-origin playwright cli or deterministic disposable session/API fixture is unavailable, unsafe to retain in redacted form or materially differs from the accepted boundary. The authorized FT-005 physical-join input is post-deployment evidence and is not a development stop condition.

constraints: Primary owner is promo; HTTP handlers and the client are adapters and may not write foreign capability state.

Use exactly the accepted ticket/cookie, endpoint paths, JSON shapes, status behavior, no-store and no-referrer rules; the purchase target is server-owned and request-overridable parameters are rejected.
Use unique disposable sessions, tickets, cookies and provider projections with known initial state, safe rerun, decisive response/state observation and cleanup limited to task fixtures.
Soft-deleted issued media remains readable; hard-purged/unavailable issued teaser IDs are skipped in original order and a disappeared item returns non-disclosing 404 without session mutation.
The final phone expiry proof joins the independent display-expiry seam from FT-005 but does not inherit its evidence or claim.

Implement one promo-boundary single-backend limiter with positive phone limit/window settings, keyed by the resolved client IP; use the accepted Caddy-overwritten X-Forwarded-For path and return 429 on every /q, /phone and /api/phone/* route before personalized disclosure.

Use the installed playwright cli against the central origin with disposable browser profiles; retain its transcript, screenshots, video and trace under .tasks/TASK-081-T3-FT-006-W2/ while omitting tickets, cookies and personalized response bodies.

Development closure uses a deterministic disposable browser/API join with the same issued session semantics. The exact FT-005 QR/session join on an authorized representative phone is deferred post-deployment evidence; when performed, it changes no display/session truth and retains only redacted comparison evidence.
invariants: Phone session_id, spa_name, authoritative visit_date and N come from the issued session; N and issued arrays never change.
Only the first currently loadable issued teaser is returned; no wider-union replacement, rebuild or recalculation occurs.
First QR exchange sets first-open/last-seen atomically; every valid repeated scan and explicit activity advances shared last-seen, while session/media reads and client timers never do.
At exact first-open or idle expiry, access is rejected or redirected, the cookie and rendered personal state are cleared, and stale access cannot revive it.
Every personalized response is protected, no-store and no-referrer; ticket, cookie, credential, payload and raw storage identity are redacted.
verification_targets: Exact-path API/client fixtures cover ticket exchange, cookie attributes, shell/session/activity/media shapes, safe redirects, strict validation, positive rate-limit settings, forwarded-client separation and 429 on /q, /phone and every /api/phone/* route.

Controlled-clock multi-phone fixtures cover 30-minute first-open, valid repeated-scan last-seen advancement, 60-minute shared idle, explicit cross-phone activity, passive non-extension, restart persistence and irreversible expiry.

The integration fixture joins the FT-005 display-expiry observation to the phone first-open and idle clocks, proving display duration, success cooldown, QR first-open and browser-idle lifetimes remain independent without adopting FT-005 proof.

A central-origin playwright cli flow covers /q -> /phone, cookie-protected session/media/activity, local expiry, clearing personalized DOM before location.replace, no durable browser storage, URL/referrer/cache isolation and rejected post-expiry reads; retain transcript, screenshots, video and trace in the task artifact directory.
Same-session fixtures cover soft-delete continuity, every hard-purge combination, historical N, ordered skip/null, CTA navigation and no foreign writes or personalized leakage.

Deterministic disposable browser/API fixtures compare session_id, СПА, authoritative visit_date, available issued teaser and N without rerunning search. The post-deployment pilot follow-up scans the exact FT-005 QR after advertising resumes on an authorized representative phone and repeats that comparison.
